Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy./Prin Secy. Home Lucknow And Anot
Counsel for Applicant :- Padam Kant Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Abhishek Misra,Satendra Kumar (Singh)
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Counter affidavit filed today by the counsel for the opposite party no.2 is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State, learned counsel for the complainant and perused the material placed on record.

The present application under Section 438 Cr.PC./482 BNSS has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime No. 0007 of 2023, under sections 419,420,467,471 of the I.P.C. and section 3/9 of the U.P. Public Examination Act, 1998, Police Station- Bijnaur, District-Lucknow Southern(Commissionarate Lucknow).

From perusal of the order sheet, it appears that on 12.12.2024, the following order was passed wherein the present applicant has been granted interim anticipatory bail:-
"Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

sentences.text: The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.0007 of 2023, under sections 419,420,467,471 of the I.P.C. and section 3/9 of the U.P. Public Examination Act, 1998, Police Station- Bijnaur, District-Lucknow Southern(Commissionarate Lucknow).
Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been planted by the police.
He added that the applicant is in no way the beneficiary as the allegation is that the other co-accused namely, Mukesh Kumar was appearing on place of Vikas Kumar Nirala.

He next added that infact, the beneficiary,
if any, is Vikas Kumar Nirala.
He submits that the applicant was not arrested on spot and there is an acute apprehension that the police will arrest the applicant.

He also submits that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is a teacher as well as law abiding citizen and he undertakes that he will always cooperate in the investigation proceedings and therefore, submission is that the applicant may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

On the other hand, learned AGA appearing for the State has opposed the contentions aforesaid and submits that there are serious allegations against the applicant and as such, he is not entitled for any relief.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and after perusal of the record, this Court finds it a fit case for grant of interim anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Abhishek Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the meantime, learned counsel for the State as well as opposite party no. 2, shall file their counter affidavits."
State counsel has failed to demonstrate from the counter affidavit that there is any adversarial fact which are pleaded in the bail application.
This Court finds that the applicant was enlarged on anticipatory bail after thorough considering the merits of the case.

The learned counsel for the State has also failed to submit any fact that the applicant is not cooperating with the investigation proceedings or otherwise any glaring fact which can adversely affect the merit of the case.
